200.description: List of canonical labels, each with its transaction type and tax event

data.description: Payload — shape depends on the endpoint

type.description: Transaction type this label maps to. null for the common labels (Ignore/Failed/Unknown) that apply to every type.

taxEvent.description: Tax event this label triggers, or null when it has none.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this label means, for UI display.
description.example: You bought digital assets. Establishes the cost basis for the asset acquired.
